economy.zh:
**经济日报·7月4日**

今日全球市场情绪复杂：美国极端热浪威胁电网与假日出行，非农数据前夕期货涨跌不一；中国A股在AI恐慌误判后反弹，港股受内地资金南下支撑；欧洲央行官员密集发声，Lagarde不排除提前离职引发猜测。同花顺盘中崩溃登上热搜，折射散户交易活跃与系统脆弱性。

- **AI算力恐慌被指“误判”**：Meta可能转向云服务的传言导致全球半导体抛售，但[SemiAnalysis报告认为恐慌“错误”](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3359278/ai-computing-stock-panic-over-meta-cloud-rumour-erroneous-analysts-say)，AI硬件过剩担忧过度。中国市场迅速反弹，[宇树科技引爆A股涨停潮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBTd0NSYUROREY3RVB4ckY3VzlhbHp5ZVMwNU9UQVM0VzZNWjRYMmUxOFc3bU0zQjh2RDRLVTFlb0diRnhWZmJPOEJhVS04RjhpZTJYcHcwY2JaYzg0VHBxVA)，体现市场对AI主线信心未变。
- **中国新能源车再现洗牌**：BYD以[超强海外交付重夺全球电动车销冠](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359287/chinas-byd-surpasses-tesla-regain-lead-global-ev-race)，特斯拉暂时落后，反映中国产业链韧性。Momenta港股IPO获[414倍超额认购](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3359360/chinas-momenta-ipo-oversubscribed-414-times-hong-kong-listings-pack-calendar)，自动驾驶赛道受资本热捧。
- **美国极端天气的经济冲击**：创纪录热浪可能[压垮电网并扰乱独立日旅行](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/extreme-heat-us-power-grids-july-4-travel.html)，能源与公用事业板块面临压力。此外，SpaceX股票首次被国会议员购买，[关联特朗普政府承包体系](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/spacex-stock-congress-meuser-cisneros-ipo-disclosure.html)，引发合规讨论。
- **欧洲经济信号分化**：BofA认为[经济增长无助于欧股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNRHBYX2pTQjJpQnR1aklQMUJINlZENUpwUXdOb0VBcE1xUFA0NmIzNlpTRWFSd1FRY2xjT3pIU0RQRThCb09YNUJtdjhiemZlNEVJcnc5cF9xN2RDaTBJWk12cnZfNkZqREpQZXVZNjluak5DZGhwUktqTUhLb1RIZGNhTktnTkFKZWRVcXdXN2tJLW5nRUFkbXFPa0ljN0N4Y0hF)，而德国改革方案推动Ibex 35涨1.4%。ECB执委Elderson呼吁[建立可信碳排放市场](https://news.google.)，强调化石燃料拖累。
- **同花顺系统事故引发关注**：中午时段[同花顺APP崩溃](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)登上微博热搜，最终确认已恢复。主力资金当日净买入2.59亿元，显示散户情绪未受明显冲击。

**后续观察**：今晚美国非农数据将决定短期利率路径，若大幅低于预期可能加剧衰退担忧。中国方面，关注HKEX 8月3日推出5年期国债期货对债市流动性的影响。欧洲央行能否在能源波动与绿色转型间保持平衡，Lagarde任期悬念或影响中期政策连贯性。
economy.en:
Markets enter a pivotal session on Friday, with U.S. futures mixed ahead of the June employment report, while a punishing heat wave threatens to strain power grids during July 4 travel. Across the Atlantic, ECB President Christine Lagarde refuses to rule out an early departure, and European stocks shrug off growth concerns. In Asia, China's AI and EV sectors dominate headlines—BYD reclaims the global EV crown from Tesla, and Momenta's Hong Kong IPO draws massive oversubscription. Meanwhile, mainland Chinese investors flock to Hong Kong stocks, and a wild rumor about Meta's cloud plans triggers a brief chip-stock panic that analysts call 'erroneous.' On the retail front, China's popular stock app Hithink RoyalFlush (同花顺) crashed during trading, sparking a social media storm.

- [U.S. stock futures mixed as Wall Street awaits key employment data](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-) — the nonfarm payrolls release later today will set the tone for rate-cut expectations; any miss could roil bonds and equities.
- [Extreme heat wave threatens U.S. power grids and July 4 travel](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/extreme-heat-us-power-grids-july-4-travel.html) — soaring temperatures risk rolling blackouts in several regions during one of the busiest travel weeks, with implications for energy stocks and GDP.
- [ECB's Lagarde won't rule out early departure](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPcjdpM2hGZElscmk5djBuNE80MlBmN0h5R1MtZWN1YXpwbThZY1FvSXR5S0J4UWxHel9zVDA1Q29DWWZVUm4tTU52bFVaSlZOYmNzVWNEYWoxamtYZ1RGY3hEdF9OQnJQZ0pXTWlLUWhkYzlCM0p5TXVaTDNRa3FJbElmaDhXaXhkWnpQc2wwZG5lSkg5dWVDOEstY3k) — the ECB chief's comment adds a layer of political uncertainty to the eurozone's monetary outlook.
- [China’s BYD surpasses Tesla to regain lead in global EV race](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359287/chinas-byd-surpasses-tesla-regain-lead-global-ev-race) — BYD’s overseas shipments surge even as domestic deliveries dip, underscoring China’s expanding EV export prowess.
- [AI computing stock panic over Meta cloud rumour ‘erroneous’, analysts say](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3359278/ai-computing-stock-panic-over-meta-cloud-rumour-erroneous-analysts-say) — a global sell-off in semiconductors was triggered by fears of an AI hardware glut, but SemiAnalysis calls it a misinterpretation; watch for sector mean-reversion.
- [Hithink RoyalFlush (同花顺) crashes, trending on Chinese social media](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) — the outage disrupted retail trading during the first hour, highlighting infrastructure fragility for China’s 200-million-strong retail investor base.
- [First known congressional SpaceX stock buys surface after record IPO](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/spacex-stock-congress-meuser-cisneros-ipo-disclosure.html) — lawmakers' purchases raise ethics questions as SpaceX deepens ties with the Trump administration.

**Watch next:** The U.S. jobs report will dominate afternoon trade, but do not overlook the ECB's digital euro speech by Piero Cipollone and any aftershocks from the Hithink outage. China's AI and EV momentum will likely carry into next week, especially if the Fed data supports a dovish tilt.

society.zh:
今日全球社会新闻焦点集中在伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊的国葬与委内瑞拉大地震的持续救援，两场人道与政治危机同步发酵。欧洲方面，波兰总理警告俄罗斯威胁升级，德国则因病假条改革引发医护反弹；美国独立日庆典遭遇热浪袭击。东亚地区，中国游客旅游偏好从日本转向韩国，日本经济数据疲软。中国国务院密集发布“十五五”规划，第二批埃博拉医疗专家组已抵达刚果（金）。知乎平台面临营收下滑与盗版打击的双重压力。

- **伊朗百万民众送别最高领袖**：哈梅内伊遗体将在德黑兰大穆萨拉清真寺停放，随后举行多日葬礼，规模堪比1989年霍梅尼葬礼。伊朗同时要求对通过霍尔木兹海峡的船只收费，作为与美国谈判的筹码（[Iran begins public mourning...](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2k4k7jqeno?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)；[Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz...](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/03/nx-s1-5879278/irans-control-of-the-strait-of-hormuz-remains-a-powerful-bargaining-chip)）。
- **委内瑞拉地震救援陷入混乱**：临时停尸房外家属含泪认领遗体，国际救援队已抵达但当地服务资源严重超载（[Anguished families...](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20y2p9qqqko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)；[‘I can only describe it as a war zone’](https://www.theguardian.com/world/ng-interactive/2026/jul/03/international-rescuers-venezuela-earthquake-hellscape)）。
- **波兰总理图斯克警告“关键数月”**：在媒体报道俄罗斯计划进攻后，波兰正为多种场景做准备（[Polish PM warns...](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj0gp88q4l4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
- **美国独立日庆祝遭热浪威胁**：百年一遇高温可能迫使多地活动取消或转移，对拜登政府应急能力形成考验（[July 4th events threatened...](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/03/g-s1-131920/up-first-newsletter-america-250-heat-wave-ukraine-russia-democratic-party)）。
- **中国第二批埃博拉抗疫专家组抵达刚果（金）**：体现中国在非洲公共卫生领域的持续投入，与西方撤离形成对比（[中国第二批埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPM3piRUFCSGNrOXdSNUhhdnJmVG1KS1p3RGVTVVhydy01OE1jYV9ObVhPMmVKVkJ4bGNScTd1bENxM3FkcFVGdGVlZTdIQjNUMmhGUWlsaHhhRlp0VTRzT0dfT0dDNE9DNFViNUhhNF8tZ01LX1BxaTF2ckhmaHl3VUFRSVVvUQ)）。
- **知乎营收下滑23.6%，网文盗版案宣判**：CEO周源强调加速AI商业化探索，但社区内容生态仍面临挑战（[知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)；[知乎盐言故事两起网文盗版案宣判...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5tMVFxc3FwRGxhek9rMHlrSGc1MFhZUUVaUkZScjBGN1ZBd0E5NGhYQmlQalA1b3c3dE9jcW1uOUs4dTJOcDRNUzdCTW8yS3NISGZVb2VsT3V3c2hacElaa21qT2pBU2NDRFozSDRsdnlzU2VPRmNwUGR2R1J2VU0)）。

**后续观察**：伊朗最高领袖去世后的权力交接与中东地缘格局变化将是未来一周最大变量；委内瑞拉震后重建需国际社会持续援助。中国“十五五”规划在教育与生态领域的细则是政策落地关键。

今日军事新闻板块呈现三大对抗主线：中东美伊直接交火、俄乌战场攻防升级、亚太多维博弈加剧。伊朗革命卫队对科威特和巴林美军基地的导弹与空袭，标志着冲突从代理人转向正面打击，全球运费飙升至两年新高；俄军在克里米亚模拟反登陆演习，乌克兰则成功破坏俄空军加固机堡，双方战法均出现质变。北约方向，美国警告俄计划攻击波兰以测试集体防御，欧洲盟国加速填补美军缩编后的防务缺口。亚太地区，台湾进行“末日入侵”演练，美方建议其构建无人机蜂巢；解放军在黄岩岛附近行动被解读为“清场”，中国空军新型KJ-3000预警机再次试飞，美国B-2隐身轰炸机被赋予反舰角色。技术层面，英国海军首次实舰发射“Nyan”自杀式无人机，美海军探索高超音速武器新部署方式，预示未来海战形态演变。

military.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in direct US-Iran hostilities, with the IRGC striking American bases in Kuwait and Bahrain—a development that dramatically expands the theater of conflict. Meanwhile, Russia continues to simulate large-scale assaults on Crimea and is reportedly planning an attack on Poland to test NATO resolve, signaling a deliberate strategy of brinkmanship. In the Indo-Pacific, China's military activities intensify: the PLA is clearing Scarborough Shoal, testing the advanced KJ-3000 AWACS, and Taiwan is rehearsing a 'doomsday' invasion scenario. Naval modernization and drone warfare remain central, with the Royal Navy launching combat-proven kamikaze drones at sea and the US Navy pushing hypersonic missile deployment. The convergence of these crises threatens to reshape global security alliances and supply chains, with freight rates already hitting two-year highs.

- **Direct US-Iran Confrontation:** [IRGC Missile And Air Strikes Hit U.S. Bases In Kuwait And Bahrain, CENTCOM Confirms](https://news.google.) — marks a major escalation, with both sides confirming strikes and counter-strikes.
- **Russia-NATO Brinkmanship:** [Russia planning attack on Poland to test Nato resolve, US warns](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQNDU4ZWx4bWlXeHVUMi1IT2dCMFY2TWk1MjdqOG9paDJ0WDlxWk5oeDU2V284Y3pYanNjVmNQc09qVllRamFjcmdidFpITG9YYk1yVFZTZWc5MURyemIxVHByYkQxa1MxeGhETmpfNkdSSWVDVDVMWFNjTDZudHJnS25feFByb0F5ZHFxeHdObEo2QXlGTGQ0UTl1NDc0VkFsb2FrMUdMUk1ueFFOUzZ3) alongside [Russia Simulates Ukrainian Crimea Assault in Large-Scale War Games](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE4yb05GV3lqQVBkbDFKZUZlX2JfaVhjWnFPVEd5Y1kybzJrZFhHUHByczVsT2JvWU9Dbm91LXNtRlEydFJMQ21PZnNKcw) suggest Moscow is testing NATO's collective defense threshold.
- **China’s Military Pressure:** [Taiwan Tests Doomsday Invasion Scenario as China Pressure Intensifies](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOVTQzZXUzR0JTNWV4MEF4Nk4tT2JBX0JvTTRQNVdfamRxQThzSDJJNnk0eFNOQVhZY3Rjd0g0Y2ZjVkxWNVpQQXRJa2JQREEwaTNibGhrOGdPb1FMajBSNE9KYmZaTzg2YXczdlliLU9vZk1xSldEbnpXZFE0QUtlME5kUy1mdzV2djlKSW9TUVR1VWlHMlc2MHhWWFU) and [解放军清场黄岩岛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNZHY4WHNWQWxkRVY5cF9ydG5rT0JneVRmU2thNE5YQkdRTWloazhlLUltNzJWaElReXJJSl9tUmwtUGtoaXBxbnFDZ3JlQlZnbkE5U2RneVNGV2ZxdmNRcTQwVnhjY1BuT1BDN1BnZm1YQzhfQXlCS1k0MXl6UVNHZFJqci1IbHhzQk5JTg) — PLA assertiveness in the South China Sea and Taiwan Strait is accelerating.
- **Drone Warfare Evolution:** [Royal Navy’s Sea Launch Of Combat-Proven Nyan Kamikaze Drone Points To Fleet’s ‘Hybrid’ Future](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxPR2p1T1JjZHZTRVZOODlYX3dqNE81TUlWQlUtOU8xOU9pNENxekxNb1RKdTk3WmRnbTU0dXQyanhtbDF5TERQcWJ2T3hGUlM3d0duZUJ5b1hWX3VBU1VlcVlGSE1RVW82XzJyUDR4YWIyck5UZ3p3VWFLSGl3Nm50RjdONlpLckdkWDY0bDVjN1pESUxPal9USVVQd3hZOUp2Szg4WUtTTVVkOGVNa2xDSklfMWliTXNzOERpMXJkbHF4Zw) and [Hardened Aircraft Shelters At Russian Air Base In Crimea Damaged From Ukrainian Drone Strikes](https://www.twz.com/news-features/hardened-aircraft-shelters-at-russian-air-base-in-crimea-damaged-from-ukrainian-drone-strikes) — unmanned systems are reshaping both offensive and defensive operations.
- **NATO & European Defense Gap:** [Europeans to fill almost all gaps left by US in NATO defense plans](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/03/europeans-to-fill-almost-all-gaps-left-by-us-in-nato-defense-plans-source-says/) and [UK Defense Spending Plan Bolsters Royal Air Force Combat Fleet](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPWWlhNzBwd2NaSGtpb3BjTVYxczhUUjRraEwzUVgwbV83LV9KLVQ3WTNHSWZOQjlla0VQZEJnN0JHRk0tODJjOFBtR2NlSnpJS0FGMS1PRnJRaGlOeWdJblZuUmpjelZVUkg5WUFEMUV3WEZmcTBNeUlzcG9VYmVCNFpzV0g4Vmtpb25INmp6RXhlTWZwTGdndmgyNGQycGtxWkprMnVkWWM0MFlyZUl3cDNhODhnZw) — Europe is forced to shoulder more responsibility as the US scales back some commitments.
- **Second-Order Economic Effects:** [Freight rates hit two-year high as geopolitics disrupt global trade](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1oNnV6VFcxZWM2LUFxN1M5M3QzZnlnUjdqRnV4Q21FVlBOT1R1U1MyUWhZMlJKcFJYbmk1eHl6SmZ0LXlmYjBYNHY3VDBpMElndDV0QW0zOA) and [How the gulf war is threatening Kenya’s food security](https://news.google.) — the conflict in the Gulf is already disrupting critical supply chains and threatening vulnerable regions.

**Watch next:** The immediate aftermath of the IRGC strikes could trigger further US retaliation and a potential closure of the Strait of Hormuz. Russia's Crimea simulations and the reported Poland attack plan may be a prelude to a new phase of hybrid warfare against NATO's eastern flank. In the Indo-Pacific, China's next move in the South China Sea and Taiwan's response to the 'doomsday' drill will be critical. The ongoing naval exercises, particularly Valiant Shield and the Nimitz's final deployment, signal that maritime deterrence remains a top priority for the US and its allies.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻中，电动汽车市场在英国迎来里程碑式突破，但特斯拉在安全与运营上面临双重考验；AI产业进入政商结合新阶段，OpenAI与Anthropic分别展开游说、合作与芯片自研；消费电子方面，核能初创迈出实质性一步但规模化路长，浏览器战争转向隐私与AI集成；HackNews社区则聚焦MSI Center高危漏洞与开源生态中的营销灰色地带。

- **英国电动化加速**：6月EV注册量猛增38%至64,440辆，市占率逼近30%创非季节性峰值 [UK EV registrations](https://electrek.co/2026/07/03/uk-ev-registrations-june-2026-30-percent-share/)。特斯拉反弹42%显示需求回暖，但得克萨斯州致命事故中司机曾搜索“FSD太胆小”后超速撞人致死被控过失杀人 [Tesla driver charged](https://electrek.co/2026/07/03/tesla-fsd-driver-manslaughter-katy-crash/)，FSD安全性再遭拷问。Robotaxi计划在迈阿密划出微小服务区域 [Tesla robotaxi map](https://electrek.co/2026/07/03/tesla-robotaxi-miami-service-area-map/)，与在德州难以扩张的现实形成反差。
- **新车型竞争加剧**：大众ID. Tiguan不是换壳ID.4 [Volkswagen's next EV](https://electrek.co/2026/07/03/volkswagens-next-ev-suv-not-just-rebadged-id-4-images/)，现代IONIQ 5上半年美国销量突破2万辆 [Hyundai IONIQ 5](https://electrek.co/2026/07/03/hyundai-ioniq-5-remains-top-selling-ev-sales-top-20000/)，起亚将PV5改装成移动赛车模拟器 [Kia PV5 simulator](https://electrek.co/2026/07/03/kia-converts-ev-van-into-off-grid-simulator-with-55-screen/)。
- **AI政治与商业博弈**：OpenAI向华盛顿提议420亿美元以避免参议院拟对AI公司征收50%的税 [OpenAI $42B](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxQTXF6TG9FWUVRakFURHdLS2RFalVnUDRIb2pNSHc1RkRNVV9OYThONUVpZ0E1WGd3SnE1Ml8yd3UybzZuNEVUbDQ4aERBM2cxM0NvVW00STN4TGpLMkNNS3ZEaXNNZ2RXZWtwMnVHdlNDWkVGRnpocm1SQ01IWjlBRTN1TQ)，Sam Altman同时提议建立美国主导的国际AI安全标准论坛 [Altman forum](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBJN3hJQ2FDNEtSZTkxRUl5XzJoUy1Edk9lTDc5THpncE1CVzBXTmpZNnVjU3V3cDNwX2xiNE93ZXFIZUhXVVpNeHk0d0ZOcEtVd1lUWmN0dEJwb1VRd2xpR2RNNTZ6NG9DM0Z1bTBJdjNlbVZGa2tXR3A2ckJKQUk)。Anthropic则与明星Sydney Sweeney合作，预示AI进入“文化时代” [Sweeney Anthropic](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPMklGN1RvS2lKaUFoSlpPd1NtTl9NNFd6VW03bTByY0EtNklEMXlxNGtFWXFMRVloajZac19xZTFxVXlkUWx5aFgwcU53ei1lWjZ5U1JnWUpXOFU1UHFMcDY2OTJkcDZpa244WWp3QVRFR3J1VmVfRkhKREJUU2RHc0NkVjZfN2Zx)，并探索与三星合作自研AI芯片 [Anthropic Samsung](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPNVpPRXJLRjlQTi1XSUhubWwxNVdpdm15MC04UEduZmJRRDh4YjNCVDFqbkFtdWhfZEtqcGZtUVR5MWRpbnNvT0xzVGI3VmM3RUZlaHJ3N01YX18xU3RuNzZud0hrWkVLTVlscjlLbUw4b1dNd3RZR19ZN1EweGFMMmtEMDUxakoybGF4bjkydEJiU1E)。同时，AI驱动的芯片短缺正推高消费电子价格 [AI chip shortage](https://www.wired.com/story/we-are-in-the-knockout-round-of-price-increases-for-consumer-electronics/)。
- **医疗与科学AI新进展**：MIT研究人员展示能复活死者眼球的新设备，为全眼移植迈出关键一步 [eye device](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/03/1140148/a-device-that-revives-eyeballs-from-dead-donors-could-make-eye-transplants-possible/)；Anthropic推出Claude Science整合科学工具 [Claude Science](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/961311/anthropic-claude-science-ai-drug-development)；Midjourney展示医疗扫描仪但缺乏验证 [Midjourney scanner](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/961265/midjourney-medical-ultrasound-scanner-behind-the-scenes-video)。
- **浏览器战争转向**：TechCrunch指出竞争不再围绕搜索，而是隐私保护、AI集成和垂直功能 [browser wars](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/03/as-the-browser-wars-heat-up-here-are-the-hottest-alternatives-to-chrome-and-safari-in-2026/)。
- **核能初创里程碑**：三家核公司新反应堆上线，但WIRED评论规模化仍有巨大鸿沟 [nuclear startups](https://www.wired.com/story/nuclear-startups-hit-milestone-why-it-matters/)。
- **HackNews社区警报**：MSI Center存在严重权限提升漏洞，可在数秒内获取SYSTEM权限 [MSI Center](https://mrbruh.com/msicenter/)；Odin项目的Wikipedia编辑争议揭示“参与度农场”现象 [Odin Wikipedia](https://katamari64.se/posts/2026/odin-wikipedia/)。

**后续观察**：今日新闻凸显了几个跨领域趋势：电动化从政策驱动转向消费者自发选择，但领头羊特斯拉的安全和运营瓶颈可能拖累行业信心；AI公司正从模型竞赛转向游说、合作与芯片自建，但芯片短缺的二次冲击不容忽视；开源社区中，安全漏洞与内容操纵问题持续发酵。本周需关注特斯拉Robotaxi在德州的实际进展、OpenAI与国会的谈判结果，以及核能初创的后续融资动态。
tech.en:
The technology landscape this week is defined by accelerating regulatory battles and market inflection points. In EVs, the UK hit a record 30% market share, while Tesla's Q2 rebound and BYD's cementing of global leadership signal a consolidating market. In AI, OpenAI's dramatic $42 billion offer to Washington to avoid a 50% tax on AI highlights the high-stakes policy fight, while Anthropic pushes into drug development and custom chips. Meanwhile, the browser wars are no longer about search, and a wave of consumer electronics price hikes driven by AI chip shortages is hitting wallets. Here are the key signals:

- **EV Milestone:** UK EV registrations hit nearly 30% in June, a record outside seasonal peaks, driven by a 42% Tesla rebound. Overall market grew 15% YoY ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/03/uk-ev-registrations-june-2026-30-percent-share/)).
- **OpenAI's $42B Gambit:** OpenAI has reportedly offered Washington $42 billion to head off a Senate bill that would tax AI at 50%, signaling the industry's willingness to pay to shape regulation ([Martin Cid Magazine via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxQTXF6TG9FWUVRakFURHdLS2RFalVnUDRIb2pNSHc1RkRNVV9OYThONUVpZ0E1WGd3SnE1Ml8yd3UybzZuNEVUbDQ4aERBM2cxM0NvVW00STN4TGpLMkNNS3ZEaXNNZ2RXZWtwMnVHdlNDWkVGRnpocm1SQ01IWjlBRTN1TQ)).
- **Anthropic Goes Biopharma:** Anthropic announced Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientists, and is reportedly exploring a partnership with Samsung for its first custom AI chip ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/961311/anthropic-claude-science-ai-drug-development); [FinanceFeeds via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPNVpPRXJLRjlQTi1XSUhubWwxNVdpdm15MC04UEduZmJRRDh4YjNCVDFqbkFtdWhfZEtqcGZtUVR5MWRpbnNvT0xzVGI3VmM3RUZlaHJ3N01YX18xU3RuNzZud0hrWkVLTVlscjlLbUw4b1dNd3RZR19ZN1EweGFMMmtEMDUxakoybGF4bjkydEJiU1E)).
- **Browser Wars Shift:** The browser battle is no longer about search but about privacy, AI integration, and vertical services. TechCrunch rounds up the hottest alternatives to Chrome and Safari ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/03/as-the-browser-wars-heat-up-here-are-the-hottest-alternatives-to-chrome-and-safari-in-2026/)).
- **AI Chip Shortage Hits Prices:** A new AI-driven chip shortage is causing prices for phones, computers, and consoles to soar again, with Wired calling it the 'knockout round' of price increases ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/we-are-in-the-knockout-round-of-price-increases-for-consumer-electronics/)).
- **Nuclear Startups Hit Milestone:** Three US nuclear startups have brought new reactor designs online, but Wired notes meaningful scale remains far off ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/nuclear-startups-hit-milestone-why-it-matters/)).
- **DeepMind Unionization Stalls:** Unionization talks at Google DeepMind are off to a rocky start, with employees accusing executives of unwillingness to engage ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/google-deepmind-unionization-talks-are-off-to-a-rocky-start/)).
- **World Cup Surveillance:** As the US co-hosts the World Cup, federal surveillance using drones and cameras is expanding, raising privacy concerns for spectators ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/961004/world-cup-america-250-surveillance-drones-cameras)).

**Watch next:** The interplay between AI regulation and corporate lobbying will intensify, especially as the US Senate bill on AI taxation gains traction. In EVs, Tesla's Robotaxi expansion into Miami faces scrutiny after Texas setbacks, and the Chevy Silverado EV's struggle to find buyers will test the 'American-made' narrative.

- [76人交易得布朗后全力追逐勒布朗，后者经纪团队确认热火、骑士、76人在列](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49252040/sources-76ers-enter-mix-lebron-james-jaylen-brown-add)
- [湖人将艾顿送至奇才换回哈迪+二轮签，释放薪资空间，重建意图明显](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49259879/sources-lakers-trading-ayton-wizards-hardy-future-picks)
- [阿根廷加时3-2险胜佛得角，梅西连续8场世界杯进球，但球队防守漏洞被放大](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49263170/argentina-break-cape-verde-hearts-extra-world-cup-lionel-messi-scores)
- [埃及点球大战4-2击败澳大利亚，赢得队史首场世界杯淘汰赛胜利](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49261233/egypt-beat-australia-pks-first-ever-knockout-win)
- [英格兰vs墨西哥开球时间因FIFA临时改期陷入混乱，最终U-turn维持原定时间](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c0ey24q42w2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- [德国主帅纳格尔斯曼离任，克洛普已与足协接触，有望接掌国家队](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49225220/julian-nagelsmann-germany-world-cup-2026)
- [新加坡羽毛球公开赛出现黑哨争议，乐蒂组合申诉无效后强势逆转](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBaaF9PZ2FaUzJGaENFX0d6Z1U3bUcxV28tU3JuN0NNSDhwMGt0MkE3ODJ0SmI2S2JpNFhWTXVic1NJRE5QZnlMMWNlV0c0b0cteU9SdXlOQmJHcVk)

**后续观察**：NBA自由市场进入第二周，76人若成功组“勒布朗+布朗”将直接威胁凯尔特人东部地位，湖人的重建筹码还需观察；世界杯16强对阵即将揭晓，阿根廷、巴西等豪门能否调整状态值得关注；德国换帅进度及克洛普的执教合同细节将是明后日焦点。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a whirlwind of NBA free agency moves and a series of dramatic World Cup knockout matches. The NBA landscape is shifting rapidly with blockbuster trades and contract extensions, while on the soccer pitch, defending champions Argentina narrowly escaped elimination, and Germany parted ways with its head coach. Here are the key developments shaping the sports world today.

- **NBA Free Agency Earthquake**: The [Jaylen Brown trade](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49254909/what-nba-execs-buzzing-jaylen-brown-celtics-sixers-walker-kessler-los-angeles-lakers-big-money-bigs-salary-cap) to the 76ers has set off a chain reaction, with Philadelphia now aggressively pursuing [LeBron James](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49252040/sources-76ers-enter-mix-lebron-james-jaylen-brown-add). Meanwhile, LeBron's agent [confirmed](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49259789/agent-lebron-eyeing-host-teams-including-heat-cavs-76ers) the Heat, Cavaliers, and Sixers are in the mix, creating a three-way bidding war.
- **Lakers Trade Ayton**: In a surprising move, the Lakers [sent Deandre Ayton to the Wizards](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49259879/sources-lakers-trading-ayton-wizards-hardy-future-picks) for Jaden Hardy and future picks, signaling a pivot away from the big-money center model.
- **Knicks Add Drummond**: After losing Mitchell Robinson, New York signed [Andre Drummond](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49262566/andre-drummond-reaches-1-year-deal-new-york-knicks) to a one-year, $3.9M deal, shoring up their frontcourt depth on a bargain contract.
- **World Cup Thrills and Spills**: Argentina [survived a massive scare](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49263170/argentina-break-cape-verde-hearts-extra-world-cup-lionel-messi-scores) against Cape Verde, winning 3-2 in extra time. [Egypt secured their first-ever knockout win](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49261233/egypt-beat-australia-pks-first-ever-knockout-win) on penalties against Australia, while Colombia [edged Ghana 1-0](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49264513/colombia-ghana-fifa-world-cup-2026-round-32) to set up a clash with Switzerland.
- **Germany Coaching Shake-up**: Julian Nagelsmann is out as Germany manager, and [Jürgen Klopp has held talks](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49225220/julian-nagelsmann-germany-world-cup-2026) with the German federation about taking over, adding intrigue to the international coaching carousel.
- **Kick-off Chaos Resolved**: After a day of confusion, the Mexico-England round-of-16 match [will kick off at 6 p.m. local time](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvgmz3jyq9qo) as originally scheduled, following a FIFA U-turn.
- **Celtics Lock Up Queta**: Boston retained center Neemias Queta with a [4-year, $56M extension](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49258502/celtics-picking-queta-option-adding-4-year-56m-extension), committing to a promising young big man.

**Watch next**: The LeBron James sweepstakes will intensify as the 76ers, Heat, and Cavaliers prepare formal pitches. World Cup action continues with more round-of-16 matches, and the NBA offseason dominoes are far from settled—expect more trades and signings in the coming days.

entertainment.zh:
今日全球娱乐头条毫无悬念地被 **Taylor Swift与Travis Kelce的世纪婚礼** 占据——两人于7月3日晚在纽约麦迪逊广场花园完婚，亚当·桑德勒担任证婚人，帝国大厦亮起蓝灯，全球粉丝与政商名流齐聚。然而，特朗普在Instagram上试图嘲讽未果，左翼博主则批评纳税人承担安保费用；与此同时，Patti LuPone的同志游轮被土耳其政府拒之门外，好莱坞再掀政治争议。中国方面，影视寒冬加剧，横店两个月仅两部古装长剧开机，而互动影游《盛世天下》与微短剧工厂则试图突围。

- [Rob Reiner在Larry David HBO剧中秘密出演华盛顿，遗作反击特朗普](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/rob-reiner-trump-george-washington-larry-david-hbo-show-1236801101/)
- [Minions & Monsters开画低于预期，北美5日仅$63.5M](https://deadline.com/2026/07/box-office-minions-monsters-1236972754/)
- [中国影视寒冬：横店两个月仅两部古装长剧开机](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE9VQ0Izc0FLOElDNDdBWU52QnktdDBNWjRFTG5NcjlZdkhhQ20tRGpjbXNUam5kVEdQYU8yOFFoZlBPNFBEX0xTS3RLaWJpOU5CSzNhZ1lKcG43NmFrUnZJNXpyaGlfcmREQ2p0dXNn)
- [《盛世天下》刷新中国互动影游天花板，'游戏+影视'迎来新风口](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5FUHp1U0pHXzkzTzAta3JleFE2VGdINElTMFdNLXdpcVB0X29sUmxFSWwxMGJEV0xGcmE0b0g3YTNUVUtuRXBMcm5lZ0pUbE93R1dVakw0M0VGUm1mLWhOT1ozYTFDbmZzTzF0dDh1ZmpTc0xmRnc)

**后续观察：** Taylor婚礼的余波将持续发酵——特朗普与左翼舆论的攻防战、布莱克·莱弗利的缺席引发的友情猜测，以及纽约公共资源使用的争议，都可能在未来数日成为社交媒体焦点。中国影视行业则在政策整治与市场冰点之间寻找微光，互动影游和AI微短剧或许能提供一线生机。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape over the past 24 hours was overwhelmingly dominated by the star-studded wedding of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce at Madison Square Garden, officiated by Adam Sandler, sparking celebrity buzz, political trolling, and social media debate. Meanwhile, other significant stories include a gay cruise ship banned by Turkey, a disappointing box office opening for 'Minions & Monsters', and Chinese entertainment grappling with a production winter and new interactive formats.

- **Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce Marry:** The couple wed July 3 at MSG with Adam Sandler officiating, in a ceremony featuring Christian Dior couture. Guests included Ed Sheeran, Bradley Cooper, Gigi Hadid, and Hugh Grant. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c982ry2pen3o), [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/taylor-swift-travis-kelce-married-1236974086/))
- **Political and Social Fallout:** President Trump attempted to troll Swift via the White House Instagram feed, while left-wing commentator Hasan Piker criticized the use of public resources for security. ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/politics-news/donald-trump-instagram-taylor-swift-wedding-msg-1236637425/), [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/hasan-piker-taylor-swift-wedding-1236637396/))
- **Notable Absence:** Former best friend Blake Lively and husband Ryan Reynolds were photographed in upstate New York and did not attend. ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/blake-lively-ryan-reynolds-taylor-swift-wedding-1236637333/))
- **Patti LuPone's Gay Cruise Turned Away:** The Broadway star's Virgin Voyages ship was banned by Turkey, leaving 2,000 mostly gay passengers stranded. She declared, “I am furious, but I am sailing.” ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/patti-lupone-gay-cruise-ship-turkey-furious-but-sailing-1236637452/))
- **Box Office Disappointment:** 'Minions & Monsters' opened to $63M over five days, well below the $80M projection, though still #1. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/box-office-minions-monsters-1236972754/))
- **Chinese Entertainment Winter:** Only two ancient-costume long dramas began filming in Hengdian in two months, reflecting a severe industry slowdown. ([联合早报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE9VQ0Izc0FLOElDNDdBWU52QnktdDBNWjRFTG5NcjlZdkhhQ20tRGpjbXNUam5kVEdQYU8yOFFoZlBPNFBEX0xTS3RLaWJpOU5CSzNhZ1lKcG43NmFrUnZJNXpyaGlfcmREQ2p0dXNn))
- **Weibo Frenzy:** Wang Junkai's concert announcement crashed Damai with 800K 'want to see' in 4 hours, and actor Jin Shijia sparked debate over body image after a belly photo. ([微博社区动态](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBxaDVJX2lULU5LbmRiSzh3aTZjMHJPYVd1YXcxTUYtbmJPcmZIVkRsQUxIOEdyY2d2czM4cDYtOEwzTW5kT3JKamVLTk9XM2piY256WXA2MUpiT1ZkSGVhU0dydw), [微博社区动态](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFB4T3RTbnRRRXFVQmNybTVqaU5ReUJHbWlxWW1ScXozYV9HSGVZRFJobnd6ZUNSYWZTXzFsemphWnhnR3RUbjBoMFFrVXlmcWI0ZVJNU1pCMlJkRFFES1phSmZ3Q3FkWDlzYllSOGVFcWtZQktPZlhoc3dtbVd2dw))

**Watch next:** The Taylor Swift wedding aftermath will continue to unfold, with potential celebrity social media posts and further political jabs. Also monitor the Chinese regulatory crackdown on online group streaming and the evolution of interactive film games as a lifeline for the struggling industry.

美股.zh: 非农数据前夕，美股期货涨跌互现。极端热浪（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/extreme-heat-us-power-grids-july-4-travel.html)）威胁电网与假日出行，可能拖累消费与能源板块。AI恐慌误判后，市场关注Ford达成质量里程碑（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/ford-achieves-quality-milestone-targets-flawless-new-vehicle-launches.html)）和SpaceX股票首次被国会议员购买（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/spacex-stock-congress-meuser-cisneros-ipo-disclosure.html)）揭示的政治资金暗流。此外，Oman在霍尔木兹海峡收费问题上的模糊态度（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/oman-strait-hormuz-fees-iran-trump.html)）为油价增添不确定性。短期看，非农数据若疲软，可能强化降息预期，但热浪若引发停电将压制风险偏好。
美股.en:
U.S. equity futures are mixed as the market holds its breath for the June nonfarm payrolls report, which will shape expectations for the Fed's next move. A simultaneous heat wave threatens to stress power grids during the holiday week, adding a layer of operational risk for utilities and travel-related sectors. Meanwhile, corporate and political news create undercurrents: SpaceX stock appears in congressional portfolios for the first time, and the Fed issued several enforcement actions.

- [U.S. stock futures mixed ahead of key employment data](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-) — any miss on jobs could reignite recession fears or, conversely, a hot number could dash hopes for a September cut.
- [Extreme heat wave threatens U.S. power grids and July 4 travel](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/extreme-heat-us-power-grids-july-4-travel.html) — grid operators from Texas to the Mid-Atlantic are on alert, with potential implications for natural gas demand and utility stock prices.
- [First known congressional SpaceX stock buys surface after record IPO](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/spacex-stock-congress-meuser-cisneros-ipo-disclosure.html) — the purchases by Reps. Meuser and Cisneros raise conflict-of-interest questions as SpaceX expands its federal role.
- [Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement actions with Small Business Bank and terminates actions with BNP Paribas entities](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/enforcement20260702a.htm) — regulatory clean-up signals the Fed's ongoing scrutiny of bank governance.
- [Ford achieves quality milestone as CEO targets flawless new vehicle launches](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/03/ford-achieves-quality-milestone-targets-flawless-new-vehicle-launches.html) — after years of recalls, Ford's turnaround narrative gains credibility; watch for margin improvement in Q3.

**Signal:** Today's jobs data is the key swing factor; a softer print could rekindle the July rate-cut narrative and lift growth stocks, while a strong number may reinforce 'higher for longer' and benefit value/energy.

中国经济.zh: A股在AI恐慌后反弹，[宇树科技涨停潮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBTd0NSYUROREY3RVB4ckY3VzlhbHp5ZVMwNU9UQVM0VzZNWjRYMmUxOFc3bU0zQjh2RDRLVTFlb0diRnhWZmJPOEJhVS04RjhpZTJYcHcwY2JaYzg0VHBxVA)与[“同花顺崩了”热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)形成鲜明对比。内地资金6月净买入港股271亿港元，偏好SMIC等AI标的（[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359267/mainland-investors-buying-mood-hong-kong-shares-favouring-smic-zhipu-ai)）。BYD重夺全球EV销冠（[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359287/chinas-byd-surpasses-tesla-regain-lead-global-ev-race)），Momenta IPO获414倍认购（[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3359360/chinas-momenta-ipo-oversubscribed-414-times-hong-kong-listings-pack-calendar)）。花旗CEO Fraser访华后表示乐观（[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359326/why-citigroup-ceo-jane-fraser-left-us-china-summit-feeling-optimistic)），释放外资对中国市场信心信号。后续关注香港北部都会区土地招标（[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3359372/caution-land-tenders-key-hong-kongs-property-recovery-analysts)）对楼市的支撑效果。
中国经济.en:
China equities rebounded on Friday after a mid-week sell-off, supported by renewed inflows via Stock Connect as mainland investors bought the dip in Hong Kong-listed AI and semiconductor names. Sentiment was bolstered by strong IPO demand for Momenta and BYD's resurgence in global EV sales. Meanwhile, Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser left Beijing optimistic after the US-China summit, signaling that top-tier global banks see opportunity in China's re-opening.

- [China stocks rebound amid U.S. jobs data influence](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOVU5YU2l6UnJ5SnNLclZzcEVOcFVnZ1FCZDltVlNFcWYxOTlvVmF0eFN2cGRkLVItZWVFenowcS1KMG9YQkhrYnFDcTBVei1RWUY2Vnh2OGtXcG5oYUtEbXF3M1VzWmx2MkU1NzI4Qzh2ZW1CcEhQZjdJSWVMaFh1eWhlSUlPbmsxdm54Ni13V0lTMnEyN09lYzNTVVBDS1FlVzRXcE5QR2kwUQ) — the CSI 300 rose 1.2% as dovish Fed expectations weakened the dollar, boosting EM assets.
- [Mainland investors turn net buyers of Hong Kong stocks in June, favoring SMIC and Zhipu AI](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359267/mainland-investors-buying-mood-hong-kong-shares-favouring-smic-zhipu-ai) — net purchases of HK$27.1 billion through Stock Connect signal a risk-on shift despite mainland regulatory headwinds.
- [China’s Momenta IPO oversubscribed 414 times as Hong Kong listings pack calendar](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3359360/chinas-momenta-ipo-oversubscribed-414-times-hong-kong-listings-pack-calendar) — the autonomous-driving start-up raised US$751 million, with strong retail demand reflecting investor appetite for AI-driven mobility.
- [China’s BYD surpasses Tesla to regain lead in global EV race](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359287/chinas-byd-surpasses-tesla-regain-lead-global-ev-race) — BYD's Q2 overseas shipments jumped 30% YoY, offsetting a slight domestic decline; the win underscores China's EV supply chain advantage.
- [Why Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser left Beijing feeling optimistic](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359326/why-citigroup-ceo-jane-fraser-left-us-china-summit-feeling-optimistic) — Fraser was among 17 CEOs who met with Trump and Xi; her positive take suggests banks expect a thaw in US-China financial ties.

**Signal:** The rotation into Hong Kong AI/tech stocks and BYD's global lead point to a selective but real recovery in China's risk assets; keep an eye on the HKEX China government bond futures launch on Aug. 3 as a new channel for renminbi exposure.

欧洲经济.zh: 欧股周一上涨，ASML带动芯片板块，但BofA警告[增长无助于欧股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNRHBYX2pTQjJpQnR1aklQMUJINlZENUpwUXdOb0VBcE1xUFA0NmIzNlpTRWFSd1FRY2xjT3pIU0RQRThCb09YNUJtdjhiemZlNEVJcnc5cF9xN2RDaTBJWk12cnZfNkZqREpQZXVZNjluak5DZGhwUktqTUhLb1RIZGNhTktnTkFKZWRVcXdXN2tJLW5nRUFkbXFPa0ljN0N4Y0hF)。ECB总裁Lagarde在接受Les Échos采访时[不排除提前离职](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPcjdpM2hGZElscmk5djBuNE80MlBmN0h5R1MtZWN1YXpwbThZY1FvSXR5S0J4UWxHel9zVDA1Q29DWWZVUm4tTU52bFVaSlZOYmNzVWNEYWoxamtYZ1RGY3hEdF9OQnJQZ0pXTWlLUWhkYzlCM0p5TXVaTDNRa3FJbElmaDhXaXhkWnpQc2wwZG5lSkg5dWVDOEstY3k)，引发货币政策连续性担忧。执委Elderson呼吁建立可信碳市场（[Contexte](https://news.google.)），强调化石燃料对经济拖累。西班牙被评为欧洲最具吸引力经济体（[EurobuildCEE](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNOVo5NThrTzhnSXp3R1JEN2Q3b01WOFVjSW1iUHBPZ2Y4cmtpRThIS0E1ZG51bkpldUhnaWo4UDkyOXE4aUNnWVhlS0hPYWtHUTcwbG84RHByZDFoS1JhZi1LSFdRbndsLTJLV295bjR6amdMWjNqQ0d1Q3BwbmRIMjZhQ05NWEp4)），吸引资本流入。美元走势（[Morningstar](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5lUHcyMWZVbnFjWmdCWWRmSmg3cm00Zk5tVk5NOUNqeUNTcXJ3ZDRET2YxOEJzTDRxSlp3WndhTzhzRXZlR2RPYmJCVWxuY0RESE40MU41aUJVendsVC1KZTMxVGFmb3NVT2JWVFo3OXE2XzhBZ1VXeVJNWVZrZ0E)）仍是影响欧元区出口的关键变量。
欧洲经济.en:
European equities rose Friday, led by a 1.4% gain in Spain's Ibex 35 on the back of Germany's reform package, while ECB officials dominated the newsflow with calls for a credible carbon market and caution on digital currencies. ECB President Lagarde fueled speculation about an early exit from her role, adding political risk to the monetary outlook. BofA warned that even better growth may not lift European stocks, as structural headwinds persist.

- [ECB's Lagarde won't rule out early departure](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPcjdpM2hGZElscmk5djBuNE80MlBmN0h5R1MtZWN1YXpwbThZY1FvSXR5S0J4UWxHel9zVDA1Q29DWWZVUm4tTU52bFVaSlZOYmNzVWNEYWoxamtYZ1RGY3hEdF9OQnJQZ0pXTWlLUWhkYzlCM0p5TXVaTDNRa3FJbElmaDhXaXhkWnpQc2wwZG5lSkg5dWVDOEstY3k) — her comment injects leadership uncertainty into the ECB's next policy steps and could weigh on the euro.
- [ECB's Elderson calls for ‘credible’ carbon market, warning of fossil fuel drag](https://news.google.) — Elderson's push for a stronger ETS could raise compliance costs for heavy emitters, directly impacting energy and industrial stocks.
- [Better growth won’t help European stocks, BofA says](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNRHBYX2pTQjJpQnR1aklQMUJINlZENUpwUXdOb0VBcE1xUFA0NmIzNlpTRWFSd1FRY2xjT3pIU0RQRThCb09YNUJtdjhiemZlNEVJcnc5cF9xN2RDaTBJWk12cnZfNkZqREpQZXVZNjluak5DZGhwUktqTUhLb1RIZGNhTktnTkFKZWRVcXdXN2tJLW5nRUFkbXFPa0ljN0N4Y0hF) — BofA argues that structural issues (energy costs, regulation) outweigh cyclical improvements; investors should rotate to defensives.
- [Ibex 35 up 1.4% on German reform package](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxNajNMaFBwdUprQlYxMGc2cTljZWx6WmZiTGFDWnVrR2NBcVV1X1pTa1hxaHdlOFV2bHhMQWE1Ri1IaG5NX2diMnpiVlhYUUNqTWd6a2lzV0FqNVpYcnlNYzJWUkR4YkpqNUpBelU0eFhtYUxlSWRhdUxJdzlvVGpjdGppQWVCLVZoNm5GcnM1Njdhd2gxeXRaNEFDRi1WaHBrS3NsRlNEZm5CN25RaEJlVVdOVFJqNGtqN3NVUzB6V0pLOG1JYTZkSm1iTQ) — Germany's announced measures to boost investment and deregulation lifted Spanish stocks disproportionately, reflecting periphery optimism.
- [Piero Cipollone: The digital transformation of money, payments and finance](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260702_1~c58dcd8150.en.pdf) — the ECB board member's speech on digital euro signals progress toward a CBDC, which could reshape banking and payment systems.

**Signal:** ECB leadership uncertainty and BofA's downgrade of the European equity outlook suggest caution. However, Spain's outperformance and carbon market reforms create tactical opportunities in green infrastructure and Southern European indices.

同花顺社区动态.zh: 7月3日上午同花顺APP大面积崩溃，[“同花顺崩了”登上微博热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)，客服回应称已反馈运营商紧急核实，午后恢复。值得注意的是，当日[同花顺（300033）主力资金净买入2.59亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBLa1FJOUFhMG5SLU9wdG5VdGpJc1p2U0hNZzhnWHFvTzNVZUFMUTB0djh4WWZFejB3elRwYU5NNTR5R2s4NHFJekRlZ1k3OUV4UHY4SXZ6WExGV3YzZVo4NGJR)，显示资金趁调整吸筹。社区内热门话题集中在宇树机器人（涨停潮）及国家发改委印发[《循环经济发展“十五五”规划》](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5rQ09ieHpUcEpvWERuT2RYRTktcHFmSk1DRFN3bmtmRllhNzNNVU1GS203ZEVaOUVmdS14T1Vfb3ZGQzJwSzNSam5nYTl2SVFYc2NGOGNNYU80cllETnBQTw)。系统稳定性问题敲响警钟，但散户交易热情未减，后续需关注监管是否对券商IT提出更高要求。
同花顺社区动态.en:
China’s largest retail trading platform, Hithink RoyalFlush (同花顺), suffered a major outage on Friday morning, causing widespread disruption among retail investors and quickly trending on Chinese social media. The company confirmed the issue was resolved but did not disclose the root cause. Separately, the National Development and Reform Commission released the '15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy,' and the official 同花顺 account reported business meetings involving Zhenhua Heavy Industries.

- [“同花顺崩了”登上热搜，回应来了](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) — the platform went down for about 30 minutes during the morning session, preventing millions of users from trading; the stock (300033) nevertheless saw net capital inflows of ¥2.59 billion on the day.
- [崩上热搜！同花顺回应：已恢复，具体原因正在排查](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE55dmhPb0o5S2Y1SDVtUWhvODdic0JoTjJJYXVDeDRDMFR4QndaVGlwcVBoYWF1MUJid202WDRXc2NFNzdzbGRtX095aE5yS29ZVFZmZVlvell2T2p1ZXpBYQ) — the outage highlights the vulnerability of China's retail-dominated market infrastructure; similar crashes in 2021 and 2023 led to regulatory scrutiny.
- [国家发展改革委印发《循环经济发展“十五五”规划》](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5rQ09ieHpUcEpvWERuT2RYRTktcHFmSk1DRFN3bmtmRllhNzNNVU1GS203ZEVaOUVmdS14T1Vfb3ZGQzJwSzNSam5nYTl2SVFYc2NGOGNNYU80cllETnBQTw) — the new circular economy plan sets targets for waste reduction and recycling rates, likely boosting related stocks in resource recovery and clean tech.
- [英伟达 (NVDA)讨论区- 股票评论- 股吧交流社区](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFA3aDBuWTBmRlZlcElORlVzUG9GaHpnbGFmWGRiLW95SmpvRWNSLS1WT3NVWTZNQmRCckZNVUFIUHdFSy1VMTluWGNIamNNYlY3TVlTdnRMOGtZRmVTZUNydw) — retail sentiment on NVDA remains active, with users discussing the Meta cloud rumor panic; the stock rebounded in after-hours.
- [上海振华重工集团与中交广航局举行工作会谈](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5JQWFYS0tnUjFUSDFGY2NiblEyREJsQzNZcWlBQUhYRWNuQnk5MmNKeV94dWpnUmRseVRvV3BxWVJhRWlqOV9PYmUzc3o5X2sxbUVuOGZuYXR4TXZMeHdUZzd3) — Zhenhua Heavy (振华重工) is advancing cooperation with CCCC Dredging, signaling infrastructure investment momentum.

**Signal:** The Hithink crash is a stark reminder of systemic risk in China's retail-heavy market; however, the stock's resilience and continued capital inflows suggest investors view the outage as a one-off glitch. Watch for any regulatory follow-up that could impose stricter uptime requirements on trading platforms.

欧美.zh:
欧美地区今日被两条重大新闻主导：伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊的葬礼与委内瑞拉强震后的救援浩劫。与此同时，波兰总理图斯克公开警告俄罗斯威胁，美国则因热浪被迫调整独立日庆祝计划。这些事件折射出地缘冲突、气候灾难与安全焦虑的叠加态势。

- 伊朗全国进入哀悼期，哈梅内伊遗体将停放德黑兰大穆萨拉清真寺，预计数百万民众参加葬礼。伊朗同时宣称要就霍尔木兹海峡通行费与美国讨价还价，显示其仍握有战略筹码（[Iran begins public mourning...](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2k4k7jqeno?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)；[Iran plans dayslong funeral...](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/03/g-s1-131963/iran-plans-dayslong-funeral-for-supreme-leader-khamenei-after-war-death)）。
- 委内瑞拉地震遇难者家属在临时停尸房外等待辨认，国际救援队形容现场“犹如战区”，当地医护与殡葬系统已崩溃（[Anguished families...](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20y2p9qqqko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)；[‘I can only describe it as a war zone’](https://www.theguardian.com/world/ng-interactive/2026/jul/03/international-rescuers-venezuela-earthquake-hellscape)）。
- 波兰总理图斯克称未来数月“至关重要”，波兰正为多种安全场景做准备，此前媒体披露俄罗斯可能计划发动攻击（[Polish PM warns...](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj0gp88q4l4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
- 美国独立日庆祝活动遭百年未遇热浪威胁，多个城市考虑取消户外活动，对政府应急管理提出严峻考验（[July 4th events threatened...](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/03/g-s1-131920/up-first-newsletter-america-250-heat-wave-ukraine-russia-democratic-party)）。

伊朗葬礼与委内瑞拉救援的持续将主导未来24小时欧美舆论，中东局势与南美灾后重建是两大长线议题。

日韩.zh:
日韩板块今日经济与社会文化信号交织：日本股市外资净买入创纪录，但日元购买力四十年来腰斩；中国游客从日本转向韩国；棒球经典赛日韩对决点燃热情，AI技术开始介入丧亲之痛。东亚社会在老龄化、经济承压与科技冲击中寻找平衡。

- 2026年外资净买入日本股票创下市场纪录，显示国际资本对日本仍有信心，但日元购买力已较40年前下降一半（[Net buying by foreign investors...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBmQUt4aEZKYjZKWXVWWmFkUk5tQnM3eFZKYXRvODBvZlVFUFNkTWNZcFN5VUp4Qi1la0gwUWl0d3A2bGtmSlZiNWZPTURBZHRfeTl4TXp2alZnLUx0dmh5UGZ3)；[Japan's yen purchasing power...](https://news.google.)）。
- 中国游客改变目的地，从日本转向韩国，韩国媒体高调报道这一趋势，可能影响两国旅游经济格局（[Chinese Tourists Abandon Japan...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOZUFOVDFha3Z6dVZYZkRNbWRadVZ5cEFGRXMwYnVrUWkxN1kyTjdwa1drYVBISkQyR00ydi1hYmp1Q0QwLWdhOGlVNHB6cTlVVTlTSG5VX2tWLTRaakdkR0ViWlNwU2dES2dyNDFrU2ZINUdmSmlONExscHNRcjB3V2RrSWNzeW5razlnLTh3bU5MNHZVSjRvS3BxVQ)）。
- 大谷翔平在WBC世界棒球经典赛中再次轰出全垒打，日本8-6击败韩国，体育盛事引发两国球迷狂欢（[8-6: Ohtani homers again...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxNOFJwTmZwU1FTcFhHOHFyaFoyNV9HSFNyU3VoWXQyV1F3Nlg2QWxVWkZfai0yR2JhNmk1Sjh1NHp0b2ZHR28wQllpNzYzMXRTU3dnT2h5YTBlMEViczk3UTJBUGZqcF9xTFR2VFB6dE5QWWdNQ3FNWHowY3NSY1psd2UzWEVpcVFIcTE4dlpNdzkwUlowVG92SUpKa1p0T0NzdU5MekJuNkhabTlWcWF2SUNBWlkwbzFSaHVBai1Bd3g)）。
- 韩国丧亲者开始尝试使用AI生成的视频与逝者“重逢”，引发伦理讨论；与此同时村上春树公开称自己的小说与AI文学“不同”，暗示对技术冲击的警惕（[Bereaved South Koreans try AI-generated videos...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPYy1sY2U3eEpmUmVJZ1JjSDh3SjlWb3BjSDIyTXJkZ08yTFhiemJvYXgyVDk0RkEzNDdEcjNVS1BRSlNzYjY0c2ZMVXRheTE0T21iMVFaOXR1cTRVRF9ZR2c3a3k4VnRuLVJmUklhMkN1Y0haR2FfekxjajVTUXRtOXE3bEFRb3pnUzNuWmVMWElfX0VJZTlqZ21VeHdmUlJNRmRtcFA4cTcwUQ)；[Murakami says his novels...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNQnh4dnR1OEFaSzdIWlBOMWpFNEJsNm4wRFg5S2N3VTZIbTIzckhYQWlJWTJzdkFKb3VRaHgzbC1XX05Sc2ktMUVaWlNQMFE0eUpoNWt5NVhkeEpMVDN0dThoNlhOSUJSMU9ZbERnanRKLWNHWmNwTkg3VEZQQnFOVUZDVlFOQQ)）。

日韩社会正在经济压力与技术创新中寻找身份认同，棒球经典赛的胜负只是暂时的情绪出口，而AI与老龄化的深层议题将持续发酵。

中国.zh:
中国今日社会新闻呈现政策密集发布与国际行动并进的图景。国务院接连印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》与《美丽中国建设“十五五”规划》，并修订电子商务法；同时第二批埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组已赴刚果（金）。官方媒体集中庆祝建党105周年，但社会层面缺乏突发性热点。

- 国务院印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》，旨在深化教育改革，提升国家教育竞争力；同日还印发《美丽中国建设“十五五”规划》，强调生态文明建设（[国务院印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE9QNTU2Y2ZBbWkxRzB4ZXpGRnRucHZod3ZBaFg5UUtucjRnOW43RXkwWjZJaHRhdVZhU1FXb0piNHNUOW14dzJCTg)；[国务院印发《美丽中国建设“十五五”规划》...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE1yVWR2Q19JNDhDalFlMUhyc3M2ZzFWNGl5V2lQU1Z1alp1Z1h3YnA4cjNzeDkxSWFNcFlCR0RPYXd3bGdCMWo0Qm45elNvUW13RElqQkhmNDFDaVVJWHpFLWlxNWZKdDhpYmZYLTBvaGRhdWk1dTJOd1NnQno2SFE)）。
- 两部门就电子商务法修正草案征求意见稿答记者问，涉及平台责任、消费者权益等关键议题（[两部门就电子商务法修正草案...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE0wU2xtbVJjTnNRSGQ5eDlVYUpTZnZ6a29rVUdjb0M5M184NFZZdUJqMjhPUDVpeGlXelJ5U1BQS1Uxa2FfQzZJM0xYY29ReVZTMDUwVkJLTk1XRUV2TzR6VENEalR3UVF1NG1xZWxXZHRsUjg2WEx0cjZINnFiYzg)）。
- 中国第二批埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组抵达刚果（金），继续提供公共卫生援助，体现大国担当（[中国第二批埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPM3piRUFCSGNrOXdSNUhhdnJmVG1KS1p3RGVTVVhydy01OE1jYV9ObVhPMmVKVkJ4bGNScTd1bENxM3FkcFVGdGVlZTdIQjNUMmhGUWlsaHhhRlp0VTRzT0dfT0dDNE9DNFViNUhhNF8tZ01LX1BxaTF2ckhmaHl3VUFRSVVvUQ)）。
- 山东临沂“亮剑”行动整治教育乱象，进一步织密暑期学生安全防护网，反映地方治理重点（[山东临沂亮剑守护教育净土...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE02TDdKN3RwMmVCSmdONFI5SWRTemdDODJZSlIxQ0tVaFh6S1ZEcmRNblhhekoyU0ltcmhiMnJWSWtGZkVhVlZZb0hOV1FhVTMxWjN5V3FPbkNxVGNFczI0Ry1EZ0Zvdi1pUVhB)；[切实织密暑期学生安全防护网...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBJR1dKZUs4eEVXdmJ1S3k4TlFJbkN1OE16UmRoQU51VHBvRkgzTy0tY1ozX2pYbGlaSmx0M0kzeVQwUDN3Vkp3SDk1TXZJT3R6TU50NVltWHlhQzNXcFNnV19uZlpLMFUwMlNv)）。

中国社会在政策引领下平稳运行，但缺乏自发性社会议题，“十五五”规划的落地细节和外援行动才是真正值得跟踪的线索。

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区今日有三条动态值得关注：平台营收继续下滑、网文盗版案宣判、以及流行文化中综艺时长过长引发的用户吐槽。这些事件共同折射出知乎在商业化、版权治理与用户体验间的多重困境。

- **知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%**：CEO周源表示将加速AI相关的商业化探索，但市场对平台内容质量与用户增长信心不足（[知乎2025年营收下滑23.6% CEO周源：加速对AI相关的商业化探索](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)）。
- **知乎盐言故事两起网文盗版案宣判**：CEO周源曾建议提高违法成本，此次判例或为行业版权保护提供参考（[知乎盐言故事两起网文盗版案宣判 CEO周源曾建议提高违法成本](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5tMVFxc3FwRGxhek9rMHlrSGc1MFhZUUVaUkZScjBGN1ZBd0E5NGhYQmlQalA1b3c3dE9jcW1uOUs4dTJOcDRNUzdCTW8yS3NISGZVb2VsT3V3c2hacElaa21qT2pBU2NDRFozSDRsdnlzU2VPRmNwUGR2R1J2VU0)）。
- **综艺时长炸到3小时引发打工人吐槽**：知乎用户热议现代综艺越来越长，吃饭刷手机都看不完，背后反映的是平台内容消费场景与用户时间碎片化的矛盾（[综艺时长炸到3小时！打工人怒吼：吃饭刷个手机都看不完](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5vMnNUYlBaREQwT1d3aDRJa0pTVHZRN0g2cHpaMXBiRTBSTjdqTFVoeE5OS0JwMlQxMHNrR0wwU0JlTHBxY1FMa3RlRUREZDA)）。

知乎社区正面临商业变现与社区黏性的双重考验，AI商业化能为平台带来多少转机，还需观察下一季度数据。

冲突局势.zh:
过去24小时，全球地缘冲突对贸易与粮食安全的传导效应凸显。全球运费因红海、波斯湾紧张局势飙升至两年新高，肯尼亚等东非国家因海湾战争面临粮食安全威胁。俄乌战场出现战术升级：俄罗斯在克里米亚模拟乌克兰登陆的大规模军演，而乌克兰则首次成功使用无人机破坏俄军萨基空军基地的加固机堡，显示无人机已具备对坚固目标的穿透能力。此外，美国警告俄罗斯可能对波兰发动攻击以测试北约集体防御决心，印日两国则联合谴责巴基斯坦跨境恐怖主义。

**收束判断：** 冲突已从单一战场向多域、多国传导，运费与粮食安全作为滞后指标开始反映军事升温，未来需重点关注俄罗斯对波兰动作及克里米亚攻防战术的示范效应。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict landscape has been reshaped by a direct strike on US bases by Iran's IRGC, a new dimension in the Gulf war that also threatens global trade and food security in East Africa. Simultaneously, Russia is escalating its military posture around Ukraine and NATO's eastern flank, simulating a major assault on Crimea and reportedly planning an attack on Poland. These developments are forcing a reassessment of escalation risks across multiple theaters.

- [IRGC Missile And Air Strikes Hit U.S. Bases In Kuwait And Bahrain, CENTCOM Confirms](https://news.google.) — the most significant escalation in the Gulf since the start of the war, confirming direct attacks on US soil bases.
- [Russia Simulates Ukrainian Crimea Assault in Large-Scale War Games](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE4yb05GV3lqQVBkbDFKZUZlX2JfaVhjWnFPVEd5Y1kybzJrZFhHUHByczVsT2JvWU9Dbm91LXNtRlEydFJMQ21PZnNKcw) and [Russian forces in Crimea prepare defenses amid fears of Ukrainian landing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQSTFNUDU0UE5jRnhlb2RELVppV2std0JSc0FGMUgyaE5wSHI2QkVEOVcyVlJidnE1dmJSa1dQa0x6ak5iUjlfclB2UkFEVHBOY3pDQ0dPMGs5OFRkRDAxSEF0LUxlZ0JLQURRcHQ3QzJyQTd5TGVTS3M4cDhId3RKeG1Pc0lQdkNfMFBuZ2ZzZDJVTmM) — Russia is simultaneously rehearsing an amphibious assault and reinforcing defenses, indicating a high degree of uncertainty about the front lines.
- [Russia planning attack on Poland to test Nato resolve, US warns](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQNDU4ZWx4bWlXeHVUMi1IT2dCMFY2TWk1MjdqOG9paDJ0WDlxWk5oeDU2V284Y3pYanNjVmNQc09qVllRamFjcmdidFpITG9YYk1yVFZTZWc5MURyemIxVHByYkQxa1MxeGhETmpfNkdSSWVDVDVMWFNjTDZudHJnS25feFByb0F5ZHFxeHdObEo2QXlGTGQ0UTl1NDc0VkFsb2FrMUdMUk1ueFFOUzZ3) — a direct warning from the US that Russia may probe NATO's Article 5 commitment through a limited attack on Poland.
- [Freight rates hit two-year high as geopolitics disrupt global trade](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1oNnV6VFcxZWM2LUFxN1M5M3QzZnlnUjdqRnV4Q21FVlBOT1R1U1MyUWhZMlJKcFJYbmk1eHl6SmZ0LXlmYjBYNHY3VDBpMElndDV0QW0zOA) and [Running on empty: How the gulf war is threatening Kenya’s food security](https://news.google.) — the economic ripple effects of the Gulf conflict are already severe, with soaring shipping costs and food shortages in East Africa.
- [Taiwan Tests Doomsday Invasion Scenario as China Pressure Intensifies](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOVTQzZXUzR0JTNWV4MEF4Nk4tT2JBX0JvTTRQNVdfamRxQThzSDJJNnk0eFNOQVhZY3Rjd0g0Y2ZjVkxWNVpQQXRJa2JQREEwaTNibGhrOGdPb1FMajBSNE9KYmZaTzg2YXczdlliLU9vZk1xSldEbnpXZFE0QUtlME5kUy1mdzV2djlKSW9TUVR1VWlHMlc2MHhWWFU) — Taiwan is bracing for an invasion scenario, underscoring the credibility of the threat from Beijing.

**Signal:** The convergence of the Gulf escalation with Russia’s war on Ukraine and China’s pressure on Taiwan creates a multi-front crisis that could overwhelm global crisis management mechanisms.

国际安全.zh:
中东局势急剧紧张：伊朗革命卫队对美军驻科威特和巴林基地实施导弹与空袭，CENTCOM予以确认，这是自本轮冲突以来伊朗首次公开打击美军驻地。与此同时，美国宣布对伊军事行动“即将结束”，七国集团表态支持必要时动用战略储备稳定能源市场。北约内部出现结构性变化：欧洲盟国宣布将填补美军缩减后留下的防务缺口，土耳其军事影响力持续上升。技术装备方面，中国KJ-3000预警机再次试飞，俄罗斯苏-57展示新防空配置，美英海军则分别测试高超音速武器与无人艇载自杀式无人机。

国际安全.en:
The international security environment is marked by a direct military confrontation between the US and Iran, urgent NATO rebalancing as the US reduces its European footprint, and rapid advances in drone and hypersonic warfare. The UK and Europe are moving to fill the capability gaps, while Russia showcases new Su-57 configurations and Türkiye expands its NATO influence.

- [IRGC Missile And Air Strikes Hit U.S. Bases In Kuwait And Bahrain, CENTCOM Confirms](https://news.google.) — a game-changing attack that forces the US to consider a broader military response in the Middle East.
- [Europeans to fill almost all gaps left by US in NATO defense plans](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/03/europeans-to-fill-almost-all-gaps-left-by-us-in-nato-defense-plans-source-says/) — confirms a historic shift in burden-sharing as the US shrinks its committed capabilities, raising questions about NATO's near-term readiness.
- [UK Defense Spending Plan Bolsters Royal Air Force Combat Fleet](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPWWlhNzBwd2NaSGtpb3BjTVYxczhUUjRraEwzUVgwbV83LV9KLVQ3WTNHSWZOQjlla0VQZEJnN0JHRk0tODJjOFBtR2NlSnpJS0FGMS1PRnJRaGlOeWdJblZuUmpjelZVUkg5WUFEMUV3WEZmcTBNeUlzcG9VYmVCNFpzV0g4Vmtpb25INmp6RXhlTWZwTGdndmgyNGQycGtxWkprMnVkWWM0MFlyZUl3cDNhODhnZw) and [The new technologies in the UK defence investment plan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOVU00R2Y5Q0ttUEd5Mlp6RE8zVmE5ck1YckRObzJxQUZIVzBfZ3JPV05CSnhxTjJhWUFqZ3lldVVMYWtJTFFpVy1vTTRaN3FoSXoycXRUeXJ2UE03bzdNVnZhbktDbkhORmJ0VEkxSXp3VWtPNXlsU3FHaGpXZXF3SjYwU1E4VnJFSG00ZkN5bFEtWXM) — London is making a major bet on air power and technology to maintain relevance alongside the US drawdown.
- [Russia Reveals Su-57 Stealth Fighter in New Expanded Firepower Air Defence Configuration](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxPVkdFVXBfeElfYnhyQm16ci0wV2FvOTRVbGFOOEZfcU5WQmtab29ibFhyMDF1VTV6WGRFa2hYWkk2bDdlLWNEZzRMYTk4eFpyNk9wbXJzWldMTEQ0alcxaWoyYW12RHNlU0RSRjhWMDdrQk5wZWpXMjZtdks3SlJyeHZn) — Moscow is boosting its air defense capabilities with the Su-57, possibly to counter NATO's stealth advantage.
- [Royal Navy’s Sea Launch Of Combat-Proven Nyan Kamikaze Drone Points To Fleet’s ‘Hybrid’ Future](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxPR2p1T1JjZHZTRVZOODlYX3dqNE81TUlWQlUtOU8xOU9pNENxekxNb1RKdTk3WmRnbTU0dXQyanhtbDF5TERQcWJ2T3hGUlM3d0duZUJ5b1hWX3VBU1VlcVlGSE1RVW82XzJyUDR4YWIyck5UZ3p3VWFLSGl3Nm50RjdONlpLckdkWDY0bDVjN1pESUxPal9USVVQd3hZOUp2Szg4WUtTTVVkOGVNa2xDSklfMWliTXNzOERpMXJkbHF4Zw) — the integration of combat-proven loitering munitions onto surface ships signals a paradigm shift in naval strike capabilities.
- [Türkiye's military reach grows across NATO](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOeTdHOUFYcUoxcklBRV9SS3NhV2JZWEpocVZZT0dycjJWVnFXRXpwZzQzcXNlMU84cjRnUnc5NV82SXBJek9IMzU5ME9Tdi1fSUVRdGw5Unh1Uk9RaVRZTGc2QlNBSFkzVm9ya1M0Ujk1Y3RSQldBUHFFWnJuYWozMU9UMHlyOVBMSUh3dXF5TQ) — Ankara is leveraging the NATO 3.0 summit to expand its military influence, potentially reshaping the alliance's southern flank.

**Signal:** The international security order is under simultaneous stress from direct state-on-state attacks and shifting alliance commitments, making the coming week critical for NATO and US force posture decisions.

中国军情.zh:
中国在南海与台海的行动密度持续上升。解放军被曝在黄岩岛周边实施“清场”行动，军事专家公开表示中国海军有能力打破他国海上演习链。台湾方面则进行“末日入侵”场景测试，美国外交官建议台湾构建无人机“蜂巢”以威慑冲突。技术层面，中国KJ-3000预警机再次试飞，被视为杀伤链关键节点；美国则将部分中国公司列入“中国军事企业清单”，商务部已回应。同时，习近平提及中朝军事交流，但朝鲜官方媒体未予报道，引发外界对中朝关系微妙变化的猜测。

- [军事专家称中国海军能打破他国海上演习链](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBrUmZnaXVQek9rbVQ0dTBuUEdNOXlsSlUydGlTRm1SVW1UVEdwT0Y4NGpicGZ6UDVFb0RVTUlhNGdEYy01UnZMa1Bua01EYkcyUExSMjk0YlNfTWVURHFocTVLRndQbHNlRkdzRXQ2LW9WZy1oTjU2UmU2THdQcjg)
